# Notes you can reuse for the next task

These templates help you explain a task to an agent or a collaborator without starting from a blank page. Copy the one you need, add real paths and examples, and delete fields that do not help with the task at hand.

- [Task brief](task-brief.md): what you want changed and how you will check it.
- [Data contract](data-contract.md): what the columns mean and how the program should handle them.
- [Handoff](handoff.md): where the work stands and what someone should do next.

They build on Part 1's [task and handoff guidance](https://fritschelab.org/practical-genai-coding-guide/docs/templates/). Visit Part 1 for the general R templates and analysis-plan examples; the three here are the ones used in this exercise.
